# Grokking Interview — https://grokking-interview.vercel.app
# Human-facing pages are fine to crawl. The raw question/answer JSON under
# /questions/ is application data (answer keys + explanations) and must NOT be
# indexed — keep it out of search results and off scraping-by-search-engine.
# (This is a request that well-behaved crawlers honor; it is not access control.
#  The site is static, so /questions/*.json remains directly reachable by URL —
#  see astro.config.mjs / netlify.toml for the actual header hardening.)

User-agent: *
Disallow: /questions/

# Sitemap (generated by @astrojs/sitemap at build). Update the host if the
# production domain changes (it derives from `site` in astro.config.mjs).
Sitemap: https://grokking-interview.vercel.app/sitemap-index.xml

# Common AI/data-harvesting crawlers: opt out of the whole site.
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /
